notes.content:
📋 Feature Adjustments:

A new endgame dungeon challenge.
[p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/ccc09afdeeb73a042ac53c06e0b31e6d9fc54714.png"]
[p align="justify"]A more detailed combat log with switchable display modes.
[p align="justify"]The new Equipment Ascension system.
[p align="justify"]Unlocks the latent potential of your gear, granting it extra stat bonuses.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/b6fbe16fb72965a3de63268f2cfa8ca9c5dd7f31.png"]
[p align="justify"]A new Easter Egg stage: the Sheep Level! In this unique Level, your Mercenaries will hold their ground, fighting off endless waves of monsters in a defensive survival challenge.
[p align="justify"] The drop rate for materials like Gems and Runes is ten times higher than in normal Levels.
[p align="justify"] No health potions or equipment will drop in this stage.
[p align="justify"] This Level is unlocked by spending a certain total amount of gold in the Shop.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/a9d461e5cd194bd74a97b538bf64be44bb1dad36.png"]
[p align="justify"]New guidance pop-ups for unlocking key features.
[p align="justify"]The Intelligence attribute has been reworked to provide a damage bonus for all skills (affecting both physical and spell damage).
[p align="justify"]Existing class sets have been buffed to be powerful enough to clear all Main Levels.
[p align="justify"]Added a new Exp Transfer feature, allowing unused mercenaries to be converted into experience.

Increased the strength of the Necromancer's summons, specifically the Skeleton Warriors.

If the party details interface remains open for more than 1 hour, it will now automatically close and the party will enter combat. (By default, the party does not enter combat while the party details interface is open.)
[p align="justify"]A new Training Dummy dungeon, accessible from the main town. Here you can check your party's DPS data and compete on a DPS leaderboard with your friends.


[p align="start"]🛠️ Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue where random class skill affixes could not be recognized in filters.

Fixed an issue where items that were not picked up into the inventory after filtering were not counted in the Codex statistics.

notes.title: The September Major Update is arriving next week!
notes.content:
[p align="justify"]Hey Adventurers,
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]The development of the September update is progressing smoothly, and we’re here to share the latest updates with everyone.


[p align="start"]All the filter optimizations and experience improvements promised in the September preview—to be delivered before the major update—have now been fully completed. Next, we’ll focus on preparing the major version for release. It is expected to arrive next Monday or Tuesday.


[p align="start"]Before the official update, let’s take another look at what was initially announced:
[olist]
A brand-new guidance system, making it easy even for complete beginners to get started.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/5df2f0ca8afdbdbc7f5e0cda01617b61a0a879dd.png"]

Optimized combat logs that allow switching to more detailed battle information.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/967c35d22ee8817931b2fabfc093a78f2b659554.png"]

Balance adjustments for all sets, along with new, more powerful sets.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/fe673cbf946d7d8f86fe2b5ce43db8cef5aa8bf3.png"]

Adjustments to the effect of the Wisdom base attribute, which also apply to already recruited mercenaries—no need to recruit them again.

New endgame challenge.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/60ce9d32c65ba684cbad2324beb12d838b69a70c.png"]

A new hidden easter egg stage that will drop large quantities of gems and runes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/ab79a236018a93319d02a06b24574566dcfb31be.png"]

A new equipment growth system.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/75face342a40d7531d0d7f1389aab25be3c291ea.png"]
[/olist]

[p align="start"]After the initial preview, everyone actively provided various suggestions in the discussion area, leading to the following additions:
[olist]
Training Dummy feature.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/575126481546b91ff7b261257a7035172240d7ad.png"]

EXP Transfer System.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/a1ae6111414fc65ee0977659472c386b70939e54.png"]


[/olist][p align="start"]More detailed update information will be revealed next week—please stay tuned. We welcome your continued feedback and suggestions!

notes.title: An Update on the Item Filter and September's Major Patch
notes.content:
[p align="justify"]Hey Adventurers,
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]Following up on our September update preview, we wanted to check in and let you know how things are coming along. We're happy to report that development is progressing smoothly, and we're still on track for our scheduled release! And yes, for everyone who's been asking, this includes the highly-requested Training Dummy for testing your DPS!
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]Additionally, as we mentioned previously, some optimizations (including the brand-new equipment filter function) will be implemented before the major September patch. This plan has not changed. We will be deploying a minor update before the major version to bring you this new filter system.
[p align="justify"]The core of this minor update is the completely overhauled filter function. It will support a high degree of customization, allowing you to fine-tune your searches by affixes, stat values, and even attributes like "Ethereal Only" It is both powerful and flexible.
[p align="justify"]We will also provide several default presets that you can use immediately. These presets can also be modified and exported, giving you the freedom to create your own perfect set of filter rules.
[p align="justify"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/9eeb3ebf5613aa8af8031a35513d7bbb645d276d.png"]
[p align="justify"]Now, I must apologize and inform you of a change in schedule. Because this feature was a complete rework from the ground up, we require more time for thorough testing. Based on our latest assessment, we can confirm that this minor update will not go live this week. The current estimated release window is next week, and the team will do everything possible to launch it sooner, hopefully as early as next Monday. We sincerely appreciate your patience and understanding.
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]Finally, let us once again share a preview of the main content that will be implemented in the major September update:
[p align="justify"]1.A new endgame dungeon challenge.
[p align="justify"]- Brings a higher level of difficulty.
[p align="justify"]- Drops all-new Set and Legendary Items.
[p align="justify"]- Drops the required materials for Equipment Ascension.
[p align="justify"]2.The new Equipment Ascension system.
[p align="justify"]- Unlocks the latent potential of your gear, granting it extra stat bonuses.
[p align="justify"]3.A new Easter Egg stage: the Sheep Level! In this unique Level, your Mercenaries will hold their ground, fighting off endless waves of monsters in a defensive survival challenge.
[p align="justify"]- The drop rate for materials like Gems and Runes is ten times higher than in normal Levels.
[p align="justify"]- No health potions or equipment will drop in this stage.
[p align="justify"]- This Level is unlocked by spending a certain total amount of gold in the Shop.
[p align="justify"]4.New guidance pop-ups for unlocking key features.
[p align="justify"]5.A more detailed combat log with switchable display modes.
[p align="justify"]6.The Intelligence attribute has been reworked to provide a damage bonus for all skills (affecting both physical and spell damage).
[p align="justify"]7.Existing class sets have been buffed to be powerful enough to clear all Main Levels.
[p align="justify"]8.A search function has been added to the stash to quickly filter for items in your inventory.
[p align="justify"]9.A new Training Dummy dungeon, accessible from the main town. Here you can check your party's DPS data and compete on a DPS leaderboard with your friends.
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]The full update will be packed with many other quality-of-life improvements and smaller tweaks.
[p align="justify"]As always, thank you for your incredible patience and support. If you have any feedback or suggestions, please don't hesitate to share them with us!

notes.title: 📅 Loot of Baal: September Update Preview
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

 

It has been two weeks since the launch of the Assassin class, and in that time, we've received a massive amount of invaluable feedback. With your support, the current version has now reached a stable state. Our heartfelt thanks to all of you!

We will continue to optimize existing issues to bring you an even smoother gaming experience.

 

Now, we are shifting our full focus to preparing for our major September update! This update will be centered on two core pillars:

A New Beginning for Newcomers - A complete overhaul of the tutorial and onboarding system to ensure every new player can get started with ease.

The Pinnacle Challenge for Veterans - Crafting more demanding and rewarding endgame content for our seasoned players.

 

A Sneak Peek at the Major Update:
[olist]
 A brand-new tutorial system, allowing players with no prior experience to quickly learn the ropes.

 Combat Log optimizations for a clearer, at-a-glance overview of the action.

 Balance adjustments for all class sets, along with the introduction of new, more powerful sets.

 Adjustments to the base effects of the Wisdom attribute.

 A new endgame challenge

 New hidden levels and easter eggs to discover

 A completely new equipment progression system
[/olist]
 

Regarding the Druid class, which many of you have asked about: rest assured, we have several new classes in the planning stages (the Druid included)! However, based on player surveys, our current priority is to first enhance and perfect the endgame ecosystem. New classes will be rolled out in subsequent major updates.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/f8ce0f311b87b7ba8c3120a8f7f8a346e5cb7d17.gif"]

Regarding Tavern optimizations: the mercenary recruitment system will be revamped alongside the release of the next new class. This will ensure that expanding the recruitment pool does not negatively impact the summoning experience.

 

As for core quality-of-life issues like the item filter, these will be implemented continuously through hotfixes, so you won't have to wait for a major version update.

If you have more ideas, we welcome you to leave your suggestions in the comments section. Let's work together to shape an even more perfect world for adventure!

notes.title: Larger-Screen Update & DLC Compensation
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

Thank you for all your feedback in the comments and community! The dev team has truly felt your passion and heard your voices. We’re currently working at full throttle to fix bugs — pulling an all-nighter today! As a small indie team, we appreciate your patience and understanding. But rest assured: we’re committed to resolving every issue, one by one.

Based on gamer's feedback, here are the immediate changes we’re making to the game:

Content Updates

We've heard your concerns about the small interface — a version with a larger interface will be released in 24 hours.

A full-screen version is also in development and will be coming soon.

New class is in the works! We plan to release the Assassin class this July to bring you a richer gameplay experience.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/99f36d6ba729f39a6cfe970cc9ca064cf5191dad.png"]

Bug Fixes

The issue where two accounts on the same PC each purchased the game and supporter pack but couldn’t claim the DLC — this will be fixed today.

A bug preventing DLC items from being claimed when your inventory is full will also be addressed.

If you’re having trouble claiming your DLC, feel free to contact us directly via Discord - Triona will fully resolve your problem— we’ll send out compensation as soon as possible.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452568/d00de4a3b03a26dd2fbb2faaed6bb7995f6fe5c4.png"]

Thank you again for your love and support! If you have any questions or suggestions, we welcome you to join our Discord Channel, where someone from our team will be ready to help.

Happy gaming!

—Gleamer Studio

notes.title: Demo Ending Soon | 1 Day Left Until Official Release
notes.content:
🚨Demo endding soon Only 1 Day Left Until Official Release!🚨 
The monsters are raring to go, ready to shower adventurers with loot! Dear adventurers, Loot of Baal will take down its demo version at 16:00 UTC on June 16, and officially launch at 02:00 UTC on June 17!



✅ Demo progress will carry over to the full version! 

⚠️ Please do not attempt to play the demo after it’s taken down — this may cause online save data corruption. All player data from the demo will be migrated to the full version, so once you purchase the game, you can continue right where you left off — no extra steps needed.

Important: If you're switching devices, please ensure your cloud save is successfully uploaded before exiting the game.

We're now in the final stages of testing and preparation.

A heartfelt thank you to all players who tried the demo and shared your valuable feedback and support.
